title: Historische database Avereest (Overijssel)
descriptions: Database with information from the Registry of Births, Deaths and Marriages of Avereest (Overijssel), and an early draft of the program with search functionalities : Avperson.exe.
description: Database with information from the Registry of Births, Deaths and Marriages of Avereest (Overijssel), and an early draft of the program with search functionalities : Avperson.exe.

relations.text: These data have possibly been used in the online database for genealogical and historical research of inhabitants comprising the addresses and dwelling places :  'Registry of Births, Deaths and Marriages' (Burgerlijke Stand Registers Avereest, HIDABA) : http://86.88.239.106/subhtml/hidaba.html (originally designed by the late Ignaat Simons, Dedemsvaart, 2001-2004).
